question: After the `deliveryRoute` build repair, should configured approval targets that were attempted but delivered no visible prompt fail closed as no-route, or should old turn-source fallback remain the default?
rationale: The code fix is mechanical, but the runtime behavior changes an existing fallback path and approval request timing for configured targets, which is a compatibility and availability contract decision.

options.title: Accept Strict Configured-Route Semantics
options.body: After the build repair, land the PR if configured approval target failures and suppressions should surface immediately as no-route responses.

options.title: Add Compatibility Mode First
options.body: Require the old fallback-after-failure behavior to remain the default and make strict configured-route failure opt-in.

options.title: Pause For Approval Owner Direction
options.body: Keep the PR paused until the gateway approval owner decides the permanent fallback and request-timing contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Strict Configured-Route Semantics
recommendation.body: After the build repair, land the PR if configured approval target failures and suppressions should surface immediately as no-route responses.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared approval work makes this person the best available routing owner for the approval lifecycle contract decision.
